name: omp-spellbook
description: omp extension: type `? <description>` in the composer and get the prompt omp's agent needs for it; `?!` gets the shell command as `!<command>`.
author: Dazzuh

omp.name: Spellbook
omp.description: Describe what you want after `?` and get the prompt omp's agent needs, written by a model that looks up omp's docs, your skills and settings and your conversation; after `?!`, the shell command as `!<command>`.

style.description: How a cast's answer arrives in the composer: diff, decode, rewind or none (no animation)

bookPath.description: Spellbook file of saved spells; a relative path sits in <omp agent dir>/spellbook, ~ is your home folder

model.description: Model or role (default '@smol') Spellbook writes prompts and commands with.
